title: Annual and Sustainability Report Design
shortIntro: Design of annual reports, ESG, and sustainability reports for listed companies, government entities, and large private groups.
fullDescription: Annual and sustainability reports are high-stakes, highly visible documents that summarize an organization's financial and social performance. They require rigorous layout systems, precise data visualization, and an ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder feedback cycles.
problemSolved: Organizations struggle to present dense financial and sustainability data in a way that is readable, engaging, and compliant. They need a designer who can handle vast amounts of text and data without losing the brand's visual integrity.
valueProposition: A well-designed report builds investor trust, satisfies regulatory requirements, and serves as a flagship piece of corporate communication. The value lies in clarity, accuracy, and process management under tight deadlines.
finalResult: A professionally typeset, brand-compliant, print-ready or interactive digital report that clearly communicates the organization's performance and strategy.

direct: Communications, marketing and corporate affairs departments
Sustainability, ESG, investor relations and annual-reporting teams

discoveryQuestions: What is the estimated page count?
Will the report be single language or bilingual?
Is the content finalized, or will it be supplied in phases?
How many charts, graphs, and tables are required?
Is there a firm regulatory filing deadline?
Who are the final sign-off stakeholders?
Do you require print coordination or just digital files?

pricingMethods.name: Fixed project price
pricingMethods.desc: Recommended when the page count and chart volume are clearly defined.

pricingMethods.name: Per-page pricing
pricingMethods.desc: Useful when the page complexity is categorized (e.g., text-heavy vs. data-heavy) and the content is stable.

pricingTiers.name: ESSENTIAL
pricingTiers.desc: For clearly defined, smaller reports (under 40 pages) with client-supplied content and limited charts.

pricingTiers.name: PROFESSIONAL
pricingTiers.desc: For complete ESG or Annual Reports requiring information design, multiple page types, custom charts, and structured review stages.

pricingTiers.name: ENTERPRISE
pricingTiers.desc: For complex, bilingual, multi-stakeholder corporate projects requiring extended coordination and strict regulatory deadlines.

typicalRisks: Long approval chains and heavy revision cycles. Late changes to financial data disrupting layout.
ethicalNote: Clean in almost every sector. Check the client's core business — a conventional bank's annual report is a common grey area worth thinking through before you accept.

title: Dashboard Design as a Service
shortIntro: Taking working-but-ugly Power BI reports and rebuilding them so executives can actually read them.
fullDescription: Business intelligence developers excel at data modeling and DAX, but often lack UX and information design skills. This service bridges that gap, focusing on information hierarchy, layout, color theory, and chart selection to turn raw data into actionable insights.
problemSolved: Executives abandon data dashboards because they are visually overwhelming, cluttered, and impossible to navigate. Data teams waste time building reports that nobody uses.
valueProposition: A well-designed dashboard increases user adoption, speeds up decision-making, and elevates the perceived value of the data team's work.
finalResult: A clear, intuitive, and brand-compliant dashboard interface, often delivered alongside a reusable Power BI theme or design system.
clientTypes: Data, business intelligence and digital transformation departments
Power BI and data consulting firms

outreachService: Power BI dashboard UX and visual design

What are the top 3 questions they need this dashboard to answer?

Are there strict corporate brand guidelines to follow?
Do you need a one-off redesign or a reusable theme file?

title: Arabic-Latin Bilingual Brand Systems
shortIntro: Identity systems that work properly in both scripts — matched type pairing, mirrored layouts, bilingual lock-ups and guidelines.
fullDescription: Creating a cohesive brand across distinct scripts requires deep typographic knowledge and cultural awareness. This service ensures that an organization's visual identity maintains its integrity, hierarchy, and aesthetic quality whether read left-to-right in English or right-to-left in Arabic.
problemSolved: Global brands entering the MENA region often suffer from mismatched typography, broken layouts, and culturally insensitive adaptations. Local entities struggle to find designers who truly understand both scripts.
valueProposition: A seamless bilingual identity prevents brand dilution, ensures professional communication across all channels, and resonates authentically with diverse audiences.
finalResult: A comprehensive bilingual brand guideline, paired typography system, and a suite of ready-to-use templates that function perfectly in both languages.

direct: Communications, marketing and corporate affairs departments

outreachContext: regional brand localization and bilingual communication
discoveryQuestions: Are we starting from an existing Latin brand, or creating a new bilingual brand from scratch?
Do you have an approved Arabic brand name and copy?
Which specific applications require immediate bilingual templates?
Are there custom typeface licensing requirements?
